title: Kanz curated drop-off points
description: Drop-off points the Kanz team has verified in person or with the operator. The file is a JSON list of entries. The backend validates every entry at load (app/places/curated.py) and rejects invalid ones.

id.description: Stable lowercase id, e.g. 'auh_corniche_clothes_bin'. Returned to the app as 'cur:<id>'.

name.description: Name as shown on site, in English.

name_ar.description: Arabic name, if the site shows one.

address.description: Street or building and area, as a visitor would look for it.

category_keys.description: Keys from facility_categories.json that this point serves.

accepted_materials.description: Only what the site itself says it accepts.

verified_by.description: Who checked it (a team member's name or initials).

verified_on.description: When it was checked, YYYY-MM-DD. Not in the future.
